text: Basic courses are: Modern Chinese Language, Listening and Speaking Skills, Communication Skills, Chinese Grammar, Selected Readings in Chinese Literature, and Business Chinese ptional courses are: Chinese History, Traditional Chinese Painting, A Survey of Chinese Culture, Chinese Martial Arts, Chinese Calligraphy, and Chinese Cooking. Study tours in China may also be arranged the whole year round. Tuition Fee CNY 1800 per month (more than 2 months), CNY 550-700 per week (less than one month) Accommodation For short term students: (less than 124 nights, not including the fees for the electricity and water) Double room: A shared room for two, CNY￥45 per day per person. Single room: CNY￥90 per day.
